purpose: Bounded self-scoped discovery of Event Schedules explicitly withdrawn from current placement, retaining their true Event and Schedule identities without inventing a temporal form.

routine.return_type: TABLE(event_ref uuid, schedule_ref uuid, title text, created_at timestamp with time zone, life_area_ref uuid, life_area_assignment_revision bigint, unschedule_operation_id text)

state_history.material_state_behavior: The routine exposes only a Schedule absence from current placement; it does not manufacture timestamps, an interval, or a replacement MaterialState.
state_history.current_binding: Actor-owned Event Schedule with a latest actor-owned unschedule receipt and no schedule_current_placement row.
state_history.chronology: The source unschedule operation id remains the exact guarded basis for a future replan.
state_history.immutability_policy: Read-only capability; replan composes existing governed undo and revision capabilities.

lifecycle.retention: Postponed discovery remains available while the Event, Schedule and unschedule receipt are retained.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No raw runtime deletion or placement synthesis.

obligations: Discovery is actor-isolated and contains no fabricated clock time or temporal form.
Runtime receives EXECUTE only and replan retains EventRef/ScheduleRef through guarded existing capabilities.
